help.diagHelp: If something isn't working, these checks show where to look. Copy them into your email to support.
help.faq.changeDate.a: Open the order in Shopify and click Change date in the Pickday box, or use Pickday > Orders. Tick "Ignore limits" to use a full or closed day. The order's tags, notes and history update. Pickday doesn't email the customer, so let them know. The shipping line on the order keeps its old name; Shopify doesn't let apps change it.
help.faq.changeDate.q: How do I change an order's date?
help.faq.checkoutBlocked.a: That's the safety check: the cart had no valid date (for example they used Buy it now, or the chosen day filled up). They go back to the cart and pick a date. If you don't need a date for every order, turn off "Date required" in Schedule.
help.faq.checkoutBlocked.q: Customers say checkout tells them to choose a date
help.faq.drawer.a: Pickday recognises most theme drawers. If yours isn't found, go to Widget & text and enter your drawer's CSS selector (your theme developer can tell you), or turn off the cart drawer in the theme so customers use the cart page.
help.faq.drawer.q: The picker doesn't appear in my cart drawer
help.faq.emails.a: No, never. Shopify sends your order emails. Add the date to them with the snippets on the Notifications page. Pickday only emails you (the daily summary, if you turn it on).
help.faq.expressButtons.a: These skip the cart, so the picker can't run. If a date is required, checkout stops the order with a message asking for a date. Many stores hide Buy it now on dated products.
help.faq.expressButtons.q: What about Shop Pay, Apple Pay and Buy it now buttons?
help.faq.fees.a: As a separate "Delivery fee" line in the cart with the fee's name. Customers see it before checkout. Pickday creates that hidden product for you; don't delete it.
help.faq.fullDays.a: Each order (or each item, if you chose so) counts towards its day and time slot. When a day is full it can't be picked. Cancelled orders free their spot. Two customers checking out in the same second can very rarely both get the last spot; you'll see the day as over the limit and can move one order.
help.faq.language.a: Yes, in 28 languages, following the language of your storefront. You can change any text per language on the Widget & text page.
help.faq.language.q: Is the picker in my customers' language?
help.faq.notShowing.a: Open the theme editor (Help > Get started, step 1), find Pickday under App embeds, switch it on and click Save. If your theme has no cart page block, add the "Pickday date picker" block to the cart template, or leave it: the embed adds the picker above the checkout button by itself.
help.faq.notShowing.q: The date picker doesn't show on my cart page
help.faq.pickupMatch.a: Checkout matching finds the location by name. Use exactly the same name for the location in Pickday and in Shopify (Settings > Shipping and delivery > Local pickup).
help.faq.pickupMatch.q: Checkout shows the wrong pickup location
help.faq.plans.a: Nothing stops at the limit: you get a 20% buffer where everything works as usual. After that, customers can still pick dates and limits still count, but new orders aren't tagged, given the order metafield or sent to Flow until you upgrade. Upgrading catches up this month's orders, and the count starts again on the 1st.
help.faq.plans.q: What happens when I reach my plan's order limit?
help.faq.privacy.a: Only the order number, the customer's first name, items and the chosen date. Addresses and phone numbers are read from Shopify when you print a sheet and never stored. Uninstalling deletes everything after Shopify's 48-hour window.
help.faq.privacy.q: What customer data does Pickday keep?
help.faq.productRules.a: Add them under Product rules > Products that don't need a date. Gift cards and products that don't need shipping never ask for a date.
help.faq.productRules.q: Some products don't need a date
help.faq.serverAsleep.a: Yes. Your settings and available days are saved inside your Shopify store, so the picker and checkout keep working. Only the Pickday admin and new order processing wait until the server is back; nothing is lost.
help.faq.serverAsleep.q: Does the picker work if Pickday is down?
help.faq.timeZone.a: Your store's time zone from Shopify settings, for everyone. Customers in another time zone see a note. Pickup locations can have their own time zone.
help.faq.timeZone.q: Which time zone does Pickday use?
help.faq.uninstall.a: The picker disappears from your store at once (no code is left in your theme). Order tags and notes stay on your orders. Your Pickday data is deleted after 48 hours. The Pickday fee product stays in your store: delete it under Products if you no longer need it.
help.faq.wrongDates.a: Check, in order: preparation time and whether it counts working days only, today's cut-off time, closed days and holidays, vacation mode, daily limits, and product rules for items in the cart. The preview on the Schedule page shows the result with reasons for each day.
help.faq.wrongDates.q: The first available date isn't what I expected

snippet.heading: Delivery details
snippet.orderConfirmation.step1: In Shopify admin, go to Settings > Notifications > Customer notifications > Order confirmation.
snippet.orderConfirmation.step2: Click Edit code and find the order summary section.
snippet.orderConfirmation.step3: Paste the snippet just above the order summary, then click Save.
snippet.orderConfirmation.title: Order confirmation email
snippet.orderPrinter.step1: Open the Shopify Order Printer app and choose a template (for example Invoice).
snippet.orderPrinter.step2: Click Edit and find where the order details are shown.
snippet.orderPrinter.step3: Paste the snippet, then click Save.
snippet.orderPrinter.title: Order Printer app
snippet.packingSlip.step1: Go to Settings > Shipping and delivery > Packing slips > Edit.
snippet.packingSlip.step2: Find the order details near the top of the template.
snippet.packingSlip.step3: Paste the snippet there, then click Save.
snippet.packingSlip.title: Packing slip
snippet.shippingConfirmation.step1: Go to Settings > Notifications > Customer notifications > Shipping confirmation.
snippet.shippingConfirmation.step3: Paste the snippet above the item list, then click Save.
snippet.shippingConfirmation.title: Shipping confirmation email
snippet.staffNotification.step1: Go to Settings > Notifications > Staff notifications > New order.
snippet.staffNotification.step3: Paste the snippet near the top, then click Save.
snippet.staffNotification.title: Staff order notification
surcharges.amountHelp: Charged once per order, in your store currency.
surcharges.errAmount: Enter an amount above zero, like 5 or 4.50
surcharges.errMethods: Choose at least one delivery method
surcharges.errSlots: Choose at least one time slot
surcharges.howBefore: Customers see the fee in their cart before they go to checkout. When they pick a date without a fee, it's removed again.
surcharges.howLine: When a customer picks a date or time slot with a fee, Pickday adds it to their cart as a separate line called "Delivery fee", showing the amount. Checkout makes sure the fee is there.
surcharges.kindDateHelp: For example Valentine's Day or Christmas Eve.
surcharges.kindSlotHelp: For example an early morning or evening slot.
surcharges.kindWeekdayHelp: For example every Saturday and Sunday.
surcharges.locked: Extra fees are part of the Pro plan
surcharges.name: Fee name
surcharges.nameHelp: A short name so you can tell your fees apart.
surcharges.noSlots: You haven't set up any time slots yet.
surcharges.none: No fees yet. Add one to charge extra for busy days, special dates, time slots or same-day orders.
surcharges.productHelp: Pickday keeps a product called "Delivery fee" in your store with one price for each fee amount. Pickday creates and updates it when you save, so you don't need to edit it.
surcharges.productHidden: It's tagged "pickday-hidden" and hidden from search. If you use automated collections, exclude this tag so the fee doesn't show up in your collections.
surcharges.productLater: Will be created when you save
surcharges.productNotLive: The delivery fee product isn't active in your online store, so fees can't be added to carts. Save this page again, or open the product and make it active in the Online Store sales channel.
surcharges.sameDayNote: The fee is added when the customer picks today's date.
surcharges.subtitle: Charge extra for busy days, special dates, early slots or same-day orders.
surcharges.taxableHelp: Turn this on if fees are taxed like your products in your country.
surcharges.title: Surcharges
transfer.codeHelp: Enter this code under Import in the other store. It works once, until {time}.
transfer.error.badCode: That code doesn't exist or has expired.
transfer.error.invalid: The settings in that file aren't valid. It may come from a newer version of Pickday.
transfer.error.locked: Importing is part of the Starter plan.
transfer.error.notPickday: That isn't a Pickday settings file.
transfer.error.shareLocked: Share codes are part of the Pro plan.
transfer.exportHelp: Download all Pickday settings as a file, or create a code to paste into Pickday in another store (for example your second store or a test store). Codes work for 24 hours.
transfer.feeNote: Fees are set up in this store when you import. Check the Surcharges page afterwards.
transfer.importHelp: Replace this store's Pickday settings with settings from a file or a share code. You'll see what changes before anything is saved.
transfer.locationNote: Pickup locations are imported by name. Check their names match your Shopify pickup locations.
transfer.locked: Copying settings by file is part of the Starter plan.
transfer.noActivity: No changes in the last 90 days.
transfer.noChanges: The imported settings are the same as yours.
transfer.productMapped: Products and collections in product rules were found in this store by their handle (web address) and will be linked.
transfer.productMissing: These products or collections weren't found in this store by handle and will be left out of product rules: {list}. Re-pick them on the Product rules page after importing.
transfer.shareLocked: Share codes are part of the Pro plan. Export and import by file work on Starter.
transfer.subtitle: Copy your settings to another store and see recent changes.
transfer.title: Import / Export
widget.accentHelp: Used for the selected date, time and method.
widget.customCssHelp: Extra styles for the date picker, up to {max} characters. Only affects Pickday, never the rest of your theme.
widget.customCssLocked: Custom CSS for the date picker
widget.drawerSelectorHelp: Only needed if the date picker doesn't show up in your cart drawer. Enter the CSS selector of the part of the drawer where it should appear (your theme developer can tell you). Leave empty to find it automatically.
widget.icons: Show icons next to delivery, pickup and shipping
widget.inputCalendarHelp: A month view. Best for most stores.
widget.inputDropdownHelp: Takes less space, good for narrow cart drawers.
widget.preselectEarliest: Select the earliest available date for shoppers
widget.preselectEarliestHelp: Shoppers can still change it. Leave this off if you want them to choose on purpose.
widget.preview.heading: Preview
widget.preview.help: This is roughly how the date picker will look. It updates as you change settings and texts. Dates here are examples.
widget.preview.matchNote: On your store, the date picker will use your theme's font and colours.
widget.productPickerHelp: Shows a date picker on the product page. The date carries over to the cart.
widget.radiusHelp: 0 for square corners, up to 24 for very round ones.
widget.setup.blockText: The date picker appears in your cart page and cart drawer on its own. To place it in a specific spot, add the “Pickday date picker” block to your cart or product template in the theme editor.
widget.setup.embedText: The app embed loads the date picker on your store. Open the theme editor, make sure Pickday is switched on under App embeds, then click Save there.
widget.setup.heading: Set up on your store
widget.showSpotsLeft: Show how many spots are left
widget.showSpotsLeftHelp: For example “2 spots left” on a time slot that is almost full.
widget.subtitle: Where the date picker appears, how it looks and what it says.
widget.texts.braces: Check the curly brackets: each opening bracket needs a closing one.
widget.texts.heading: Texts and translations
widget.texts.help: Change any text shoppers see. Leave a field empty to use Pickday's built-in text, which is already translated.
widget.texts.noBuiltIn: Pickday has no built-in {language} texts yet, so shoppers see English unless you add your own here.
widget.texts.tooLong: Longer than the recommended {max} characters, so it may not fit on small screens.
widget.themeDarkHelp: Dark box with light text, for dark themes.
widget.themeMatchHelp: Uses your theme's font, text colour and background.
widget.title: Widget & text
